Position: Medical Science Liaison, Cardiovascular Location: Houston, South Texas & Louisiana The MSL role embodies our medical mission to be recognized as the trusted partner for internal stakeholders and the healthcare community, driving scientific exchange to enhance medical education, data generation, insight generation and patients’ access to medicine. The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is responsible for identifying disease and product related medical needs in a defined geography. The primary role of the MSL is to develop and maintain relationships with Thought Leaders (TL) and Healthcare Providers (HCP) within their healthcare system. The purpose of their interactions is to engage in meaningful scientific exchange that will ensure patients have access to BMS medicines, to ensure their safe and appropriate use through peer to peer discussions aligned with medical strategies and needs expressed by external stakeholders, and to facilitate research. The MSL also serves as the medical resource for external stakeholders in the community. External Environment and Customer Focus Develop and maintain relationships with academic and community research thought leaders, appropriate HCPs, and access stakeholders, within a given geography to answer scientific, unsolicited product, and HEOR related questions. The MSL will use various channels for interactions (1:1, group presentations, remote, etc.) Demonstrate proficiency in using available scientific resources and presentations. Effectively present information to TL/HCPs and be able to respond to questions, ensuring medical accuracy and compliance with local procedures, ethical and legal guidelines and directives. Actively assess the medical landscape by meeting with TL/HCPs/Access Stakeholders to understand their needs and expertise. Continuously update own knowledge in treatment strategies, products, unmet medical needs, clinical trials, health economics outcomes research and scientific activities. The role The Associate Director - Case Management Standards and Compliance will be responsible for leading the development, implementation, and oversight of robust case management standards and compliance frameworks within Eli Lilly and Company. Oversee the implementation and effectiveness of compliance monitoring programs for case management activities across all relevant functions and regions. Conduct regular audits and assessments of case management processes to identify potential compliance gaps, risks, and areas for improvement. Develop and deliver comprehensive training programs to ensure all personnel involved in case management activities are proficient in relevant standards, regulations, and systems. Act as a subject matter expert on case management compliance, providing guidance and support to internal stakeholders, including Pharmacovigilance, Quality Assurance, and Regulatory Affairs. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate and resolve compliance issues, implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and monitor their effectiveness. Represent Eli Lilly during regulatory inspections and audits pertaining to case management, ensuring accurate and timely provision of requested documentation and information. Stay abreast of global pharmacovigilance regulations, guidelines, and industry trends to proactively identify and address potential impacts on case management compliance. Contribute to the development and enhancement of case management systems and tools to optimize efficiency and ensure compliance. Prepare and present regular reports on case management compliance status, key metrics, and identified risks to senior leadership. In-depth knowledge of global pharmacovigilance regulations and guidelines (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA). Demonstrated experience in developing, implementing, and overseeing compliance programs in a highly regulated environment. Strong understanding of case processing, medical coding (MedDRA, WHODrug), and safety database systems. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify complex issues and develop effective solutions. Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders at various levels. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely. Experience with regulatory inspections and audits is highly desirable.
